about-p1: I'm a Data Scientist & Full Stack Developer with over 8 years of experience turning multi-source data into business decisions, production pipelines, executive dashboards, and GenAI solutions for companies and government agencies.
about-p2: I work end to end, from problem modeling to delivery, with Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, Docker, Spark, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI, plus applied experience with LLMs, RAG, and embeddings. I build from the backend (Python, Flask, APIs) to the frontend (React).
about-p3: I'm pursuing a PhD in Business Administration at UFSC and I'm the founder of Xplore Dados, an AI SaaS platform for academic research with 19 tools in production that I build and maintain single-handedly. Highlights include an 85% reduction in data preparation time, 100+ BI dashboards, and solutions that supported strategic decisions at a global level.

project-tagline: AI SaaS platform for academic research
project-summary: An AI SaaS platform for academic research that I design, build, and maintain single-handedly: 19 tools in production, a Flask backend, PostgreSQL on Supabase, and an AI layer that orchestrates OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google under one streaming protocol.
project-pillar-1-text: Hybrid retrieval that blends keyword search with semantic similarity, boosted by academic section and guarded against redundancy. A four-stage pipeline validates, deduplicates, and anchors every citation to the exact passage in the source PDF.
project-pillar-2-text: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google normalized into a single streaming protocol, with fallback chains, mid-response retries, and credits charged only after a generation completes successfully.
project-pillar-3-text: An HNSW index over cosine similarity and diversified retrieval solved in SQL, guaranteeing minimum coverage per document so no single file dominates the context sent to the model.
project-pillar-4-text: A custom HySCo-KC method fusing co-occurrence networks, semantic similarity, and topic modeling with configurable weights, alongside Bradford, Lotka, and Zipf laws and thematic evolution analysis.
project-pillar-5-text: Stripe subscriptions with idempotent webhooks, atomic credit debits inside Postgres itself, Brazilian e-invoicing, a partner program with a public API, and a bilingual interface.
project-pillar-6-text: Per-request CSP nonces, an application firewall with progressive banning, 168 row-level security policies, structured logs with PII masking, and CI that validates the reversibility of every migration.
